source_caption:
🎬 Dear John (2010)

Dear John follows John Tyree, a young soldier who falls deeply in love with Savannah Curtis, a college student he meets while on leave in South Carolina. Their unexpected romance quickly develops into a powerful connection, but when John returns to military service, the couple must maintain their relationship through heartfelt letters and long periods apart. As time passes, unexpected circumstances, family responsibilities, and difficult decisions begin to test their love. Despite the distance and challenges they face, John and Savannah struggle to hold on to the promises they made to each other. Starring Channing Tatum and Amanda Seyfried, the film delivers an emotional story about love, sacrifice, heartbreak, and the difficult choices that can change two lives forever.

🎭 Genre: Romance • Drama • War

⭐ IMDb: 6.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 48m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Lasse Hallström

✍️ Writer: Jamie Linden

📚 Based On: Dear John by Nicholas Sparks

📺 Where to Watch: Check Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Dear John is a 2010 American romantic war drama film directed by Lasse Hallström, based on the 2006 novel by Nicholas Sparks. It follows the life of a soldier (Channing Tatum) after he falls in love with a young woman (Amanda Seyfried, who decide to exchange letters after he is deployed to Afghanistan. Dear John was released in North America on February 5, 2010, by Sony Pictures Releasing. The film received mixed reviews from critics, and grossed $115 million against a $25 million budget.
